newsitem.title: USA: El Salvador buys 4,000 tonnes U.S. PL-480 vegoil.
newsitem.headline: El Salvador buys 4,000 tonnes U.S. PL-480 vegoil.

text.p: El Salvador bought 3,000 tonnes of prime bleachable summer yellow (PBSY) cottonseed oil in bulk and 1,000 tonnes of crude sunflowerseed oil under the PL-480 Title I export program, its U.S. export agent said.

The sale included 2,500 tonnes PBSY cottonseed oil from Gersony-Strauss Co, Charleston, S.C., out of which 1,000 tonnes was bought at $587.15 a tonne, 500 tonnes at $592.67 and 1,000 tonnes at $594.87, the agent said.
Another 500 tonnes of PBSY cottonseed oil was purchased from Pasternak Baum and Co at $603.60 a tonne.
It bought 1,000 tonnes of sunflower seed oil from Archer Daniels Midland at $534.90 a tonne. All commodities were FOB and bought from Houston, Texas.
Both commodities were slated for October 1-15 shipment.
